hero.lead: Lighting, wall art and accents shaped by hand, chosen for rooms that are lived in and loved.

row1.alt: Artisans finishing a piece by hand
row1.title: Pieces with a maker behind them
row1.body: Every lamp, frame and vessel we carry is shaped in small workshops across India. We work directly with artisans, so the craft stays honest and the details stay sharp.

row2.alt: Lighting collection: gold pendants, a chandelier, a wall sconce and table and floor lamps in a warm living room
row2.title: Light, texture and the art of a calm room
row2.body: Good interiors are built in layers: a warm pendant over the table, a sculptural lamp by the sofa, a frame that catches the eye. Our collections are designed to sit together, so it is easy to build a room that feels considered.

row3.alt: Two gold-framed shell mandala wall art pieces above a cream sofa on an olive green wall
row3.title: Walls that tell your story
row3.body: From hand-painted canvases to sculpted metal and shell art, our wall décor turns a blank wall into the room's focal point. Pieces are made to be grouped or to stand alone, in finishes that catch the light through the day.

row4.alt: A hand-painted elephant procession showpiece on a gilded tusk-shaped stand on a marble console
row4.title: Small pieces, big presence
row4.body: A gilded figurine on the console, a sculpted centrepiece on the coffee table: showpieces are where a room shows its personality. Ours are detailed by hand, made to be noticed and kept for years.

row5.alt: A white ceramic vase painted with blue peonies, with gold baroque handles and base, against a deep blue wall
row5.title: Vessels worth displaying on their own
row5.body: Hand-painted ceramic, blue pottery and gilded classics: a good vase is beautiful with flowers and just as striking without. Choose one hero piece or build a cluster in varying heights.

row6.alt: Three gold shadow boxes of feathers, shells and coral above a cream sofa and a fluted marble coffee table
row6.title: Depth, framed
row6.body: Shadow boxes bring texture to a wall that flat prints can't. Shells, feathers and sculpted forms sit in deep frames, so every piece casts its own shadow and changes with the light.

row7.alt: A gilded Victorian vase with hand-painted pink and purple flowers and ornate gold handles against a plum wall
row7.title: Old-world grandeur, made for today
row7.body: Gilded handles, hand-painted florals and crackle-glazed finishes: our Victorian pieces bring the drama of a period home to a modern room. Set one on a console and let it hold the space.

row8.alt: An amber glass two-tier pendant light glowing above a round marble dining table
row8.title: Light, designed the Italian way
row8.body: Clean silhouettes, tinted glass and a soft, even glow. Our Italian lighting is about restraint: one well-chosen pendant over the dining table changes how the whole room feels after dark.

row9.alt: A handblown glass dolphin in clear, amber and green glass on a light wooden side table
row9.title: Shaped by breath and fire
row9.body: Every piece is blown and shaped by hand, so no two are quite the same. Swirls of colour sit inside clear glass and catch the light from every angle, on a shelf, a desk or a sunny windowsill.
